title: Benowitz's APRO membership application

tellings.quote: they said, "What's your favorite UFO book?" And he said, "Books by Heinick." That's all he said.

plain: When a man named Paul Bennewitz applied in the late 1970s to join a civilian UFO research group based in Arizona, the Aerial Phenomena Research Organization, he left one line on the form that the writer Greg Bishop finds telling. Bishop says on the show that he has seen the application. Asked for his favourite UFO book, Bennewitz wrote only "Books by Hynek", meaning the astronomer J. Allen Hynek, and "that's all he said", which Bishop takes as a sign of how new Bennewitz was to the subject at the time.
